Title: Service Fabric version 6.5 runtime and SDK are in development

Body.Content:
Service Fabric version 6.5 runtime and SDK contains new features, improvements, and some bug fixes.
This will include GA of features currently in preview, including:

  • Support for applications and services as ARM resources
  • Managed Identities integration for applications
  • Support for AZ aware / cross AZ clusters

Learn more about Azure Service Fabric.
